Text must read "ROLF STREET CAR SALES" exactly, no extra words or tagline. Keep the emblem inside the left 22% of the canvas, isolated from all text so it can be cropped for a favicon. Flat clean graphic design with thick simple forms, no gradients, no photographic textures, no 3D, no background, no mockup, no decorative tiny lines. Include a crisp white outer keyline around the dark shapes and a fine dark edge on any white shapes so this same transparent artwork remains legible on white, charcoal and dark-red website backgrounds. Restrained expert typography. Compact symbol must remain distinctive at 32px. Not a dealer-approved logo.
